steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Electrical power P = VI, measured in watts (W); 1 W = 1 J/s. | Key Fact: Using Ohm's Law, power can also be expressed as P = I²R or P = V²/R. | Key Fact: Electrical energy E = Pt, measured in joules (J); domestic energy is billed in kWh. | Key Fact: Resistors dissipate power as heat; this must be within the resistor's power rating to avoid damage.
